current_coloc_gwas.evidence: Decima was evaluated post-training on eQTL Catalogue study QTS000038. That study resolves to the OneK1K PBMC cohort, GSE196830, rather than GSE289173. Project COLOC memberships were not training labels, but eQTL scoring is a downstream-demo task family.

gse244832.evidence: GSE244832 was public after the original preprint but before the first immutable weight record. It is not a declared named corpus, but the 8856-task metadata and checkpoint-bound sample alias manifest have not been acquired.
gse244832.topology: same_sample_different_aliquot; no false cell-level RNA-ATAC pairing

gse281160.evidence: GSE281160 became public after the first immutable weight record. Its guide-linked expression perturbation outcomes were not checkpoint targets.
gse281160.topology: same_cell guide and RNA; biological inference aggregates to experimental replicate and target family

gse281364.evidence: GSE281364 became public after the first immutable weight record. Its HepG2 and LX-2 MPRA allele activities were not checkpoint targets, although Borzoi initialization supplies generic sequence and functional-genomics priors.

gse289173.evidence: The original Decima preprint predates GSE289173 public release, and the declared training sources do not include it. The first immutable weight record follows the GEO release and no checkpoint-bound sample manifest is available, so the 48-donor cell states and signed cell-type eQTL and interaction-eQTL outcomes are target-label-unexposed with medium confidence, not clean-declared. QTS000038 is OneK1K GSE196830 and is not an alias for this seal.
gse289173.topology: single-nucleus RNA plus evaluator-only cell-type eQTL and interaction-eQTL summaries; no ATAC

gse296875.evidence: GSE296875 became public after the first immutable weight record and is not a declared training source. Its 39-donor same-nucleus RNA and ATAC outcomes remain development-only.

resource_atlas_current.evidence: Resource donor labels, MASLD phenotypes, and the frozen 117 programs are not declared checkpoint targets. Exact overlap of source cells with Decima's large SCimilarity-derived training collection remains unresolved, so donor-label exposure is provisionally target-label-unexposed with medium confidence.

held_out_behavior.context: Decima has no donor or RNA input. At the same allele, target gene, sequence window, gene mask, and fixed output task, every donor receives the same prediction.
held_out_behavior.locus: Borzoi initialization and Decima training expose broad reference sequence and functional-genomics biology. Variant evaluation crosses donor folds with merged chromosome or LD blocks and a 524288-bp boundary buffer.
held_out_behavior.sealed: GSE289173 labels may not choose output tasks, task aggregations, target genes, transcripts, windows, masks, calibration, thresholds, or direction rules.

interpretation: Decima can natively emit signed ALT-minus-REF gene-expression effects, but only for a fixed catalog of output contexts. It does not accept sealed RNA as a new context. Primary GSE289173 eligibility remains blocked until the exact 8856-task metadata is frozen and independently maps all four prespecified lineages without sealed-label tuning.

rules.checkpoint_chronology: The original preprint supports training-design chronology, but the 2025-03-27 immutable weight record controls artifact chronology. A clean declaration requires a checkpoint-bound accession and sample manifest.
rules.fixed_task_ontology: A cell task is eligible only under its released metadata identity. Similar names, disease states, bulk tissues, or broad parent cell types cannot be relabeled to fill a missing evaluator lineage.
rules.gene_and_task_selection: Freeze the target-gene, transcript, gene-mask, output-task, and any task-aggregation rule entirely from upstream ontology and development evidence before sealed inference.
rules.genome_overlap: Reference sequence overlap is encoder exposure and is controlled through held genomic or LD blocks and a 524288-bp boundary buffer.
rules.sealed_rna: The model cannot consume sealed RNA. Sealed expression may not select or weight output tasks unless a separately named development-trained model and selection lock already define the operation.
rules.variant_sign: Use benchmark ALT-minus-REF and v0.7.2 or later fixed-axis fixtures. Never use the pre-v0.7.2 ensemble VEP result.

sealed_output_roster.selection_rule: An ontology-only one-to-one or prespecified aggregation crosswalk must be frozen without GSE289173 outcomes. If any lineage lacks a defensible matching output task, Decima is ineligible for the primary full-roster endpoint and remains a supported-task secondary comparator.

task_data_gate.current_coloc_gwas: Downstream-demo genetic task family; project COLOC memberships remain development-only and cannot confirm the model.
task_data_gate.gse281160: Exploratory perturbation direction diagnostic only; Decima has no guide or donor RNA input.
task_data_gate.gse281364: Retrospective gene-linked MPRA direction and rank diagnostic after a development-only gene and fixed-task crosswalk.
task_data_gate.gse289173: Conditional primary eligibility only after exact metadata acquisition, a complete four-lineage ontology crosswalk, terms resolution, artifact admission, and selection lock. Otherwise secondary supported-task static sequence analysis only.
task_data_gate.gse296875: Static gene-centered sequence comparator or development-fitted head only. Same-nucleus RNA and ATAC cannot turn Decima into an RNA-conditioned model.
task_data_gate.resource_atlas_current: May support development-only output-task crosswalk diagnostics without using frozen programs as training or selection targets.
